title: Race conditions and latest result
description: Practice race conditions and latest result using injected asynchronous operations, deterministic Node 24 tests, cancellation and failure cases with no external network dependency.
objectives: Predict race conditions and latest result behavior before executing an asynchronous operation
Diagnose the starter's race, ordering or error-handling defect
Prove cancellation, ordering or failure behavior with deterministic offline tests
rubric: I can explain the scheduler, cancellation or failure rule in race conditions and latest result.
I reproduce a failing starter with a real Promise or injected transport.
I verify the success and failure paths without public network calls.
